title: the live Godot editor
instructions: Host commands are gdsh commands run in the open Godot editor (the Editor Console's commands when that addon is enabled): 'tree root | tree nodes --recursive', 'ls res://', and so on. Resource paths (res://...) and node paths are plain arguments the editor interprets; they are not files in this shell. Start with list_commands, then '<command> --help' or the help tool for subcommands and flags. Changes made through commands are real edits to the open project; prefer inspecting before modifying.
setup: In each Godot project: run 'godot-shell addon install' in the project folder, then enable the godot-shell plugin in Project Settings > Plugins. It needs gdsh (gdaddon install brohd11/godot-gdsh), and offers editor_console's commands when that addon is enabled. Bridge settings (port, token, commands) go in ~/.agent-shell/godot/bridge.json or res://.agent-shell/godot/bridge.json. Set GODOT_SHELL_PORT / GODOT_SHELL_TOKEN here if the bridge uses another port or a token.

host.hint: open the project in the Godot editor with the godot-shell plugin enabled (install it with 'godot-shell addon install')
